writing_rules: Load this template, the registered blank skeleton, and the time_process system contract before structurally editing the world runtime owner.
completed_reviews is the central latest semantic receipt map keyed by process id; it is evidence of review, not a second gameplay authority.
A continuous process may advance its frontier cursor only when its receipt is advanced in the same transaction after all covered owners and causal successor actions are resolved.
Receipt coverage_ref and coverage_count must match the process coverage used for that settlement; inline coverage uses null coverage_ref.
A no_op receipt means the covered state was actually reviewed and no material change was supported; absence of a write is never itself a no-op receipt.
Do not add an unregistered field. A new field requires maintenance-time template/schema revision first.
